name: Power Muzukiel
source:
A Power angel who belongs in the sixth circle in the angel hierarchy. Her primary duty involves managing the habitats of insects on the surface world, and regulate their populations. The genes of every type of insect in the world are in her body, and she’s able to utilise male semen to produce as many new insects as may be required. To accomplish her ecosystem preservation tasks, she sometimes needs to secure men for seeding purposes.

Due to the various genes inside her body, she’s frequently mistaken for a monster. Also due to these insect genes, she has a high potential for combat, and is able to descend to the surface world to take part in combat. During those times, Muzukiel will sometimes secure a Sinner to assist her in her reproductive duties.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
